evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: Establishes a recurring future cadence and frames an untested rollback as a hypothetical absence, stating a general principle rather than a specific event.
Labels a planned recurring activity with a named artifact, pointing at a concrete future schedule.
Asserts the current owner of the rollback rehearsal program as a settled fact tied to a named individual.
